name: Dispatchers: an OS point that two or more machines take, called for the selected track's machine
description: A part of model27's builder, not a machine (notes/63 §4): compiled once into dispatch.o by tools/gen_parts.py, added by tools/compose.py to a build in which two or more machines take the same vtable entry. The entry goes to the part's dispatcher; the composer writes the data block (each machine's method by machine number) right after the part's code. A point one machine takes keeps that machine's own entry, so SAMPLE alone does not change.
